svg.title: Existing hooks; no consumer replacement
svg.desc: The listener implements the existing FeatureModule interface. Matching runs directly in afterExecute; no new AST-consumer adapter is needed. FeatureModule.h is unchanged; its lifecycle hooks are already in the parent. The tidy module neither takes nor replaces the existing ASTConsumer.
svg.text: The listener implements the existing FeatureModule interface. Matching runs directly in afterExecute; no new AST-consumer adapter is needed.
/// remain consistent with the preamble, which may already have been built.
/// The preprocessor has not received EndSourceFile() yet.
/// fixes, and before it is returned to the caller.
// Warning options must precede frontend initialization: module loading in
// BeginSourceFile() can consult their severity to decide whether to fail.
// Preamble builds don't call beforeBeginSourceFile(). Running tidy there
// would duplicate diagnostics and interfere with PCH generation.
// Run the AST-dependent part of the clang-tidy checks.
// (The preprocessor part ran already, via PPCallbacks).
// Preserve the previous suppression policy when no checks are active.
FeatureModule.h is unchanged; its lifecycle hooks are already in the parent.
The tidy module neither takes nor replaces the existing ASTConsumer.
Source: 101584320859 → c64f1fca38c6 • Exact snapshots; arrows map responsibilities, not every line
